build_fconv_self_att_model: build a fairseq FConvModelSelfAtt convolutional encoder-decoder model with self-attention from args and task
create_fconv_encoder: create an FConvEncoder convolutional encoder with configurable layers, dropout, and optional self-attention
create_fconv_decoder: create an FConvDecoder convolutional decoder with linearized convolutions, attention, and self-attention layers
review_selfattention_module: review the SelfAttention module that uses DownsampledMultiHeadAttention with query, key, value projections and layer norm
configure_fconv_self_att_wp_architecture: configure the fconv_self_att_wp architecture preset with gated attention, downsampling, and project input enabled
